The '''Siege of Belasco''' was a confrontation that took place around [[16,800 BBY]] at the [[Expansion Region]]<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CSWE Belasco">{{CSWECite|I|67|Belasco}}</ref> [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]]. It was situated in the [[Exploitation Region|region]] actively controlled by the [[Grand Companies]]&mdash;[[Merchant/Legends|trading]] conglomerates based along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as [[the Spin]] and backed by [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;and lay along [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes controlled by Coruscant.<ref name="EGTW" />

The Siege of Belasco was a late engagement of the [[First Alsakan Conflict]], a war that had commenced more than [[17,018 BBY|two centuries]] earlier, lasted for another [[16,700 BBY|hundred years]], and was the first of a fourteen-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of wars over [[Politics/Legends|political]] control of the Republic between Coruscant, the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Siege of Belasco was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
